name: Image-space silhouette extraction with perturbation
definition: A technique that extracts surface silhouettes in image space using edge detection filters, optionally modified by a procedural perturbation function for artistic variation, and combines them with DVR for depth perception.
summary: Image-space silhouette extraction with perturbation enhances volume rendering by applying edge detection and optional procedural noise to extracted silhouettes, offering interactive performance for large datasets without expensive mesh processing.
